messages:
jessica: :rotating_light: seeing repeated OOMs on hosted-pool-A during long-context requests (>=64k tokens). worker-11/12/14 all hit OOM killer within 2-6 minutes of stream start. KV cache live_bytes grows steadily past configured capacity and eviction doesn't seem to free pages. attaching quick logs below.

arjun: thanks, digging in now. rough hypothesis: slab fragmentation + eviction path regressed after last kernel selection change. profiler shows many small allocations pinned across pages so compact pass isn't reclaiming.

mike: was that the attention-kernel swap we rolled last night? we pushed new kernels to improve perf on short ctxs, might have changed allocation alignment. rolling that back is the fastest mitigation if confirmed.

lina: ran a quick `redwood-admin kv-stats --node worker-12 --pool hosted-pool-A` output: total_entries=1_240_321, live_bytes=68_432_102_400, evicted_bytes=1_024_000_000, failed_evicts=19, compactable_fragments=1_893_248. looks like evict requests are returning success but bytes not reclaimed (fragmented).

arjun: paste of the evict/log snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T22:09:12Z] evict_request id=0x7f2a status=ok evicted=4096 pages freed=0 pinned=4096
[2026-03-16T22:09:12Z] slab_compact start nodes=12 estimated_reclaim=0
[2026-03-16T22:09:13Z] evict_retry id=0x7f2a attempt=1 -> err=page_pin
[2026-03-16T22:09:14Z] oom_killer invoked pid=2213 comm="inferd" rss=65GB
```
This shows evict succeeded at entry level but freed bytes=0 because pages are still pinned. repeated retries bump live RSS until OOM.

mike: ok rolling back kernel change on pool A now -> `deploy rollback --pool hosted-pool-A --to r2026.03.14-kernel-v2` (starting). I'll post when done.

lina: short-term mitigation already applied by deploy-bot: lowered `max_active_contexts` for pool A from 120 -> 32 and toggled `strict_kv_eviction=true` to force synchronous evict path. perf impact expected but prevents OOM.

arjun: proposed short/medium/long plan:
- short: rollback kernel (mike), run forced compact pass on all affected workers (lina), enable eviction retry backoff + cap attempts (arjun).
- medium: add guard in batcher to limit per-request sequence length for hosted-pool-A and surface 413/503 when request too big; fallback to smaller model variant automatically when KV memory > 60GB.
- long: redesign slab allocator compaction to avoid pinned-page fragmentation (research/eng-runtime), and improve kernel selection tests to include long-context mem profiles.

jessica: also add graceful-degradation behavior in API: if eviction fails N times -> return 503 with `Retry-After` and route to cheaper CPU fallback or smaller model. Users should get a clear signal instead of silent OOM.

mike: rollback complete on pool A (r2026.03.14 active). monitoring... current metrics: live_bytes dropping on worker-12 from 68GB -> 44GB in 3 min.

lina: running compact script (live): `sudo rwinfer-compact --node worker-12 --force` found ~1.7GB reclaimable, now reclaimed. repeating across nodes.

perf-bot: Auto-mitigation: `max_active_contexts` reduced and `strict_kv_eviction` enabled on hosted-pool-A. Alert suppression active for 30m.

arjun: I'll open a PR today for: eviction retries (max_attempts=3 -> then fail fast), eviction metrics (`failed_evicts`, `pinned_pages`), and a compact-on-threshold job. tagging @eng-runtime for review.

jessica: action items: Mike - validate rollback stability & monitor 30m; Lina - finish compaction on remaining nodes; Arjun - PR for eviction retries + metrics; Jess - doc API degrade behavior + 503 spec. We'll convene a postmortem if anything else OOMs. Thanks all for quick response :thumbsup:
